description:
## What

`regenerate-docs.yaml`'s `push.paths` filter used brace-expanded
extension groups (e.g. `packages/ui/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}`).
GitHub Actions path filters only support `*`/`**` glob wildcards —
brace expansion is not part of the supported filter syntax. This
workflow has **0 recorded runs** in its entire history, despite
numerous qualifying commits to `packages/{ui,types,utils,theme,error-testing}/src/**`.

## Fix

Expand each brace group into its own explicit path entry so the
trigger condition actually matches source file changes.

Also regenerated the one drifted API doc this silent failure caused:
`packages/theme/src/utils/token-transformer.ts`'s `mergeThemes`
already takes `Partial<ThemeConfig>` for its second parameter, but the
last-generated docs still showed the pre-change `ThemeConfig` type
(from #824).

## Verification

- `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(...)"` — YAML parses cleanly
- `pnpm --filter @sparkle/docs docs:automation` — regenerates
  `docs/src/content/docs/api/theme/src.md` with no further diff
- `pnpm check` / `pnpm build` / `pnpm test` — clean on this branch

## Scope

Config-only change to a workflow trigger condition + one regenerated
doc file. No behavior changes to the documentation generation logic
itself.
